scenarios.name: test-copy-cards
scenarios.why: Generated by lab/cmd/xmageport from XMage SpelltwineTest#testCopyCards.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[play-amount-all-min1]: DB$ Play | Amount$ All without Optional$ is posed as a modes ask with Min 1 (engine/effects/play.go:330-345), so only one copy (Lightning Bolt) is cast and Shock never is; Oracle 'Cast the copies if able' makes casting both mandatory. CR 707.12, 608.2c. Secondary (translation, non-strict-choose-mode-defaults): no setStrictChooseMode, XMage AI targets the opponent while gorge's fallback aimed the Bolt copy at p0.

scenarios.name: test-copy-cards-mirari
scenarios.why: Generated by lab/cmd/xmageport from XMage SpelltwineTest#testCopyCardsMirari. 2 XMage choice(s) gorge never asks were dropped.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[copy-retarget-ignores-subability-targets]: copyTargetDeclarations returns only the top SA for a non-modal spell (engine/rules/target_modes.go:1043-1047), so Mirari's copy of Spelltwine can only retarget its first target (Night's Whisper); the TgtOpp sub-ability target stays Blasphemous Act and addTarget Divination is unused. CR 707.10c. Secondary: play-amount-all-min1 (engine/effects/play.go:330); and translation cast-mana-from-pool-leaves-lands-untapped (runner pays Spelltwine from the pool, 9 Islands stay untapped so Mirari re-triggers on the cast copies and is paid: life 16, hand 6).
